text:
sam: Heads-up — we need a quick "jumpstart" flow for enterprise onboarding where delegated admins can grant route access + quotas. thinking a 3-step modal: select tenant -> pick routes -> assign preset role. thoughts?

jess: +1. presets should map to policy templates (read-only, quota-admin, billing-viewer). keep it simple for sales demos. :rocket:

mike: backend constraint: we currently have scoped-token create and role-bind APIs. scoped-token is ephemeral (no persisted binding). do we want persisted bindings or just token issuance?

tara: UX: keep modal short. show an estimated impact preview like "estimated rps / monthly tokens" and a telemetry badge that explains cost/latency tradeoffs.

rong: security: must create an audit entry and capture actor id + change reason. also routing policy service needs to see entitlements so requests are routed correctly (rbac-aware routing). telemetry should add tag: rbact_change=console and rbact_actor=...

mike: API proposal: add POST /admin/role-bindings/bulk-apply that returns a preview/diff. sample payload:```json
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "bindings": [
    {
      "principal": "team@acme",
      "role": "quota-admin",
      "routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"]
    }
  ],
  "dry_run": true
}
``` response would include previewed effective privileges and any route-scope mismatches.

jess: can dry_run be the modal "Preview" step? show predicted errors/warnings inline before Confirm. show a small explainer for why a route is denied.

sam: rollout idea: behind feature-flag, 10% orgs -> 50% -> GA. telemetry events: rbac_modal_preview, rbac_modal_confirm, rbac_modal_error (with error_code). keep old flow as fallback for orgs excluded from flag.

permissions-bot: Notice: feature-flag rbac_jumpstart enabled for org=acme in staging.

tara: copy nit: inline help should read: "Granting quota-admin allows assigning per-route throughput limits — use cautiously." maybe a link to docs.

rong: security sign-off conditions: audit log required, require MFA for org_admins on Confirm in prod, and ensure role templates are immutable once released (versioned).

mike: created INF-1234 to track API work (bulk-apply + preview). i'll draft PR and include sample responses. tagging @jess @tara for preview copy/ux review.

jess: thanks — i'll mock the modal screens and presets mapping.

sam: great — next steps: mike API PR, jess/tara mock, rong confirms audit + MFA requirements, then canary rollout plan. :white_check_mark:
